stories.title: OBC panel formed ahead of UP panchayat polls:Retired judge Ram Avtar Singh gets charge to frame reservation report
stories.summary: The UP government has constituted the State Local Rural Body Dedicated Backwards Classes Commission (OBC Commission) for the Panchayat elections. The commission's tenure will be 6 months. Retired Justice Ram Autar Singh of the Allahabad High Court has been made the chairman of the commission. Additionally, 2 retired Additional District Judges (Brijesh Kumar, Santosh Vishwakarma) and 2 retired IAS officers (Dr. Arvind Chaurasia and SP Singh) have been included in the commission. The commission's report may come by November 2026. After this, the reservation will be decided. It has become clear that Panchayat elections will only be possible after the Assembly elections of 2027. On February 4, 2025, the High Court had ordered the government to constitute the commission. The chairman of the commission and both retired Additional District Judges have previously served as chairmen of the OBC Commission constituted in 2022 for determining reservation for backward classes in urban local body elections. The commission led by Singh had submitted its report within three months. The Supreme Court also agreed with this report and gave the green light for conducting the local body elections. Retired IAS Dr. Arvind Chaurasia and SP Singh have been included as new members. All members in the commission, except SP Singh, are from backward classes. Chairman Ram Autar Singh comes from the Jat community. Meanwhile, Santosh Kumar Vishwakarma is from the Lohar community, Brijesh Kumar Swarnkar, and Dr. Arvind Chaurasia are from their respective communities. Chairman Ram Autar Singh told Dainik Bhaskar: The commission's office will be established soon. After that, I will take charge of my duties. The commission will talk to all sections of society and visit districts. After this, a report will be prepared. The commission will strive to present the report before the stipulated deadline. Commission Chairman, a resident of Bijnor, served as High Court Judge for 3 years Commission Chairman Ram Autar Singh was born on January 15, 1949, in Bijnor. He started his career in PCS (Judicial Service) in 1976. In 1991, he was promoted to Higher Judicial Service. In 2005, he became a District Judge. Thereafter, he served as a Judge in the Allahabad High Court from 2008 to 2011. Meanwhile, retired IAS Dr. Arvind Kumar Chaurasia was promoted from PCS to IAS in 2012. He has also served as the District Magistrate of Lakhimpur. Additionally, he has worked as Special Secretary in the Irrigation Department. Why was the Backward Class Commission formed? Based on the report and survey of the Backward Class Commission, it will be decided which Panchayat seat in your area will be reserved for OBC (female or male) and which will remain general. In fact, the Supreme Court had stated that before providing OBC reservation in local bodies (such as Gram Panchayat, Zila Panchayat), states must complete the process after a 'Triple Test', i.e., a three-tier investigation. This commission has been formed to complete this triple test. The commission will collect data on the OBC community. If the government had directly implemented the reservation without the commission's report, the matter could have been stuck in court and the panchayat elections could have been halted. With the formation of the commission, elections can now be conducted in a legally secure manner. The commission will have 3 main tasks- Collecting data- The commission will investigate the population of backward classes in local bodies (at block and panchayat levels) and their need for political representation. A report will be prepared on this basis. Adhering to the 50% limit- The commission will ensure that the total reservation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes combined does not exceed 50%. Determining the reservation ratio- Based on the commission's recommendations, the number of reserved seats in each local body will be determined according to the proportion of the OBC population. Term of Panchayat members completing this month The last Panchayat elections in UP were held in 2021. The 5-year term of the Panchayats is completing by May 25-26, 2026. According to constitutional rules, new elections should have been completed before the expiry of the current term. This means Panchayat elections in UP were scheduled to be held before May 2026 or in the month of May itself. However, before the announcement of elections in UP, the matter reached the High Court. The High Court ordered fresh reservation by forming an OBC commission. This is why elections will be held a year late this time. In such a situation, the Panchayati Raj Department has sent a proposal to the Cabinet for the appointment of an administrator or the formation of an administrative committee to manage affairs after the term of the village heads (Gram Pradhans) ends. The proposal may get approval in a few days. However, about two months ago, in an interview given to Bhaskar, Panchayati Raj Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar had said that the Panchayat elections would be held by July 12.

Mayawati refuses to meet Congress delegation:Leaders reached without prior notice; discussion starts again on BSP-Congress tie-up in UP
stories.summary: Congress's attempt to form an alliance behind the scenes with BSP chief Mayawati backfired. On May 19 (Tuesday), the Congress Scheduled Caste (SC) department national president Rajendra Pal Gautam, MP Tanuj Punia, and other leaders suddenly arrived to meet Mayawati. However, Mayawati did not meet them. She sent them back from the gate. Returning empty-handed from the BSP chief's residence created a storm in UP politics. Congress MP Imran Masood himself reprimanded his leaders. He said, I am in favor of meetings and interactions in politics, but arriving to meet without an appointment like this was wrong. Is Congress exploring the possibility of an alliance with BSP in UP, leaving SP? Why did Imran Masood give the example of Bengal on SP chief Akhilesh Yadav's formula of offering 'guaranteed winning seats'? Congress leaders wrote down their mobile numbers and returned A meeting of the Congress Scheduled Caste Department was held at the Congress headquarters in Lucknow on May 19. After this, the national president of the department, Rajendra Pal Gautam, Congress MP from Barabanki, Tanuj Punia, and other leaders suddenly reached Mayawati's house. They asked the security guard at the gate to call Mayawati's private secretary, Mewalal Gautam. They requested an appointment to meet Mayawati. According to sources, Congress leaders waited at the gate for about 10 minutes. Then a message came from inside that Behan ji (Mayawati) was busy and the meeting would not be possible now. After this, the Congress leaders wrote their names and mobile numbers at the gate and left. However, pictures of this attempted meeting by Congress leaders went viral. After this, there was a stir in politics. Political meanings began to be drawn from this meeting. News spread that Congress was exploring possibilities of an alliance with BSP, leaving SP, in the UP assembly elections. Rahul Gandhi was also in Raebareli on May 19. In such a situation, it was directly claimed that these leaders wanted to meet Mayawati with a message from him. Both leaders also have a background linked to BSP Among the Congress leaders who arrived to meet Mayawati, Rajendra Prasad Gautam has been an old BSP member. After leaving BSP, he joined the Aam Aadmi Party and then Congress. Barabanki MP Tanuj Punia is the son of senior Congress leader and former MP PL Punia. When Mayawati was Chief Minister, PL Punia was her principal secretary. At that time, he held significant influence among UP bureaucrats. This is why political analysts are not considering it a normal meeting. They are considering it part of the secret diplomacy of the alliance. Mayawati's denial certainly put a question mark on Congress's strategy. There is a discussion in political circles that the BSP chief will not agree to an alliance through any leader below the level of Rahul Gandhi or Priyanka Gandhi. The sudden, uninvited attempt by Congress leaders to meet her probably did not please Mayawati. Why is Congress exploring possibilities of an alliance with BSP in UP? Senior journalist Syed Qasim says - Congress feels that it will not get the desired seats in an alliance with SP. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav himself had given a statement regarding the 2027 assembly elections at an event on May 19. He had said that he would give seats to alliance partners based on the Lok Sabha election formula. In this, the formula would be a guarantee of victory, not just a seat. While Congress wants to strengthen itself in UP. Congress wants 125 assembly seats, with at least one seat in every district. SP wants to contest around 350 seats itself in UP. It feels that if it contests fewer seats, it will be difficult to defeat BJP. SP also cites examples of Bihar, Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, and Assam. Imran Masood recalled Bengal results On May 20, Congress MP Imran Masood from Saharanpur reacted to Akhilesh's statement. He said, "I would say, no seat, no victory. When there are no seats, where will the victory come from? Everyone should think about this. Especially, such people should learn a lesson from the Bengal results." If it had been fought strategically in Bengal, the India alliance would have won the election. What the Election Commission did is a different matter. This kind of mistake must be avoided in UP. However, he did not name the SP during this time. Congress had to do damage control after BSP's stance After returning empty-handed from Mayawati's house, Congress went into damage control mode. UP Congress President Ajay Rai clarified on May 20, saying, "This was a personal program of those leaders. No official order was given by the party." Ajay Rai's statement further increased the confusion. On one hand, Congress wants an alliance with BSP, on the other hand, the party is trying to back down by calling it 'personal'. Rajendra Pal Gautam himself said that Mayawati is the former Chief Minister of the Dalit community. That's why he went to meet her to inquire about her well-being. Tanuj Punia also called it a "general visit". He said that Behan Ji is a senior leader of our community. She is 70 years old. We went to inquire about her health. SP chief alerted after Tamil Nadu incident SP is on alert after the Tamil Nadu incident. Akhilesh also does not agree with the way Congress broke its 22-year-old alliance and immediately joined TVK after the results. Now, as Congress leaders tried to meet Mayawati, he must have become even more cautious. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav made a measured post on X on May 20. He also reminded Congress of its weak organization in UP. He conveyed the message that Congress benefited from SP's strong organization in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, which is why it was able to win 6 seats.

stories.title: 9 UP leaders in BJP national executive race:Harish Dwivedi gains ground after Assam success strategy; Kataria seen as key Gurjar face
stories.summary: Major changes are likely in the national organisation of the Bharatiya Janata Party. Preparations are underway for the announcement of the new national team under party president Nitin Naveen, who took charge on January 20, 2026. The new team is being closely watched in political circles. Party sources say young leaders may get more importance this time to ensure better coordination between the president and office bearers. Sources also said the BJP is preparing its team while keeping the 2027 Assembly elections in mind. Leaders from different caste groups in Uttar Pradesh may be included to maintain social balance. One Brahmin, one Thakur, one Vaishya and 2-3 leaders from backward classes are likely to get a place in the new team. Know about the changes in the national team Currently, many big names from UP are included in BJP's national team, in which there are indications of major changes this time- These 9 big contenders from UP for the 'Naveen' team Strength: He is very close to PM Modi, Amit Shah, BL Santosh, and Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath in the central leadership. He played a crucial role as in-charge in forming the BJP government in Assam and Tripura. Strength: He was the strategist behind the one-sided victory in the Assam elections and is close to Amit Shah. Recently, he was also a strong contender for the post of UP State President. Strength: Extremely trusted by the top leaders of the organization and the Sangh (RSS) (BL Santosh, Arun Kumar). Currently working as a bridge between the government, the Sangh, and the organization. Strength: A big 'Gurjar' face of the BJP. To thwart SP's attempts to infiltrate the Gurjar vote bank, he may get an important position in the national team. Strength: Gupta, who started his journey as an ordinary worker, is an expert in election management. He is a prominent leader of the Vaishya community. Recently, he was also in the running for state president and cabinet expansion. Strength: He has been continuously active in the organisation since 2010. He has long experience in implementing programs at the grassroots level and in election management. Good hold in the Sangh. Strength: Close to former Governor Kalraj Mishra and trusted by Home Minister Amit Shah. Long experience in the media in charge and as a spokesperson. Strength: Comes from the Bhumihar community. In charge of PM Modi's parliamentary constituency, Varanasi. Has successfully completed many major campaigns. Strength: A prominent Brahmin face from Western UP. He has been the former National Media in charge. Currently, he is handling the responsibility as the In-charge of Himachal Pradesh. Significance of being included in BJP's National Executive - UP organisation will also change. Pankaj Chaudhary's list is ready Along with the national team, the announcement of UP's new state executive may also happen soon. Pankaj Chaudhary, who became the state president on December 14, 2025, has gone to Delhi with his new list. Along with the state executive, several regional presidents will be replaced after reviewing their performance. Amidst discussions of sending stalwarts like Santosh Singh, Vijay Bahadur Pathak, Amarpal Maurya, and Kanta Kardam to the central organisation, new and diligent workers will be given a place in the state organisation.

stories.title: Ballia salary scam exposes fake appointments:Peons worked as Shiksha Mitras too, crores paid despite recruitment ban
stories.summary: Rameshwar Singh is a peon at Ramkaran Inter College in Bhimpura town, Ballia. His appointment was on July 1, 2005. Surprisingly, Rameshwar has also been deployed as a Shikshamitra (para-teacher) in the town's Composite School since August 23, 2015. He is drawing a salary and honorarium for both positions. Similarly, his real nephew, Shivamangal Singh, is also a peon in the same college. Additionally, he is a Shikshamitra in a government school in the town. Shivamangal's wife, Vibha Singh, is also a peon in the same college. In Ballia, 179 such fraudulent appointments were made, and 45 crore rupees in salary and arrears were paid. In Azamgarh, Jaunpur, Mau, and Agra too, 194 fake peons, clerks, and teachers are looting the government treasury by securing jobs with forged documents. Despite the Education Director's ban, crores of rupees in salaries are being paid. Nephew is older than his real uncle The details of Shivamangal Singh, who is drawing a peon's salary and Shikshamitra's honorarium in Bhimpura, and his real uncle Rameshwar Singh are available on the Manav Sampada portal. It is known that Rameshwar became a Shikshamitra from the 'Ex-Serviceman' quota. This means he has also served in the army. DIOS who filed the FIR are themselves breaking the rules The story begins in 2018. Ramesh Singh, who served as District Inspector of Schools (DIOS) in Ballia between 2018 and 2022, made appointments to 179 posts of peons, clerks, and teachers in secondary schools and Sanskrit secondary schools. Many sons and relatives of influential people were among them. Assistant teachers were also recruited in non-aided Sanskrit secondary schools by showing attachments. Then, salaries were also released from the treasury. On July 5, 2024, when Devendra Kumar Gupta became DIOS, he stopped the salaries of these 179 fraudulently appointed individuals in July itself. Additionally, on September 9, he informed the then Additional Chief Secretary (ACS) by writing a letter. He had written - Ramesh Singh has made permanent appointments by showing backdates, despite the outsourcing rules applicable to the recruitment of peons. Devendra Gupta filed an FIR at Ballia Kotwali in February 2025, regarding the disappearance of files related to 179 fake appointments. Former DIOS Ramesh Singh, his assistant Sanjay Kumar Kunwar, Senior Assistant Ajay Singh, Urdu translator Muhammad Mainuddin, and Head Clerk Shivanand Tiwari were named as accused in the case. Following this, all 179 people went to court regarding the withholding of their salaries. The High Court ordered an investigation into the matter and payment on January 8, 2026. Taking advantage of this, the current DIOS Devendra Kumar Gupta paid salaries and arrears amounting to Rs 45 crore to all 179 people by March 2026. High Court ordered an investigation by forming a committee 27 petitions related to this matter reached the High Court. On January 8, 2026, the High Court also ordered the formation of a committee to investigate the 179 fake appointments. It had said - there is a dispute over the appointments and salaries are being paid from the government treasury. In such a situation, it becomes important that an investigation be conducted by forming a committee. The order also stated that any salary being issued would be investigated. If irregularities are found, the payment will be recovered. The order included the Director of Secondary Education, the Financial Controller, and the District School Inspectors of Ballia, Agra, Azamgarh, and Mau in the committee. The High Court had stated that the committee would issue notices to all management committees and principals of inter colleges, demanding documents related to appointments. A period of 3 weeks was given for this. Colleges had to submit the documents within 2 weeks of receiving the notice. There was also an order to seek the help of the Inspector General (IG) of CBCID if needed during the investigation of the documents. The committee had to prepare its report 4 weeks after receiving the documents. Based on this, the Directorate of Education had to decide whether the appointment of 179 employees was valid or invalid. On the order of the High Court, the Director of Secondary Education formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT) on February 4, 2026. On February 5, documents related to 179 appointments and a report were requested from Ballia DIOS Devendra Gupta. Which has not been sent by Ballia DIOS till date. Due to this, the investigation could not be completed. No trace of the SIT investigation formed in 2025 either Before this, on January 20, 2025, Special Secretary Yogesh Kumar had formed a two-member SIT to investigate fake appointments made in non-governmental aided secondary and Sanskrit schools in Ballia, Agra, Azamgarh and Jaunpur. It included Director General of School Education Kanchan Verma and CBCID IG M. Rajesh Kumar. Additionally, the Additional Chief Secretary (Secondary Education) was instructed to provide the documents of all individuals with fake appointments to the SIT. The education mafia of Ballia filed a writ petition in the Lucknow bench of the High Court to stop this SIT investigation. Then, Special Secretary Yogesh Kumar stated in an affidavit submitted to the court that the SIT investigation was very close to completion. On this, the court ordered the SIT investigation to continue and to investigate all four districts, including Ballia. However, even after more than a year has passed since then, there is no trace of the SIT's investigation report. ACS stopped payment, DIOS released ₹45 crore Then Additional Director of Education Surendra Kumar Tiwari had stopped the salary payment of 179 fraudulently appointed personnel in Ballia on February 13, 2026. Despite this, DIOS Devendra Gupta released ₹45 crore as salaries for all 179 employees in March. In response, it was stated that the salary was paid on the basis of a contempt notice issued by the High Court. Whereas, the court should have been informed of the entire matter in the contempt petition, which was not done. Despite DM's recommendation, Devendra is posted in Ballia Ballia District Magistrate Mangala Prasad Singh had written a letter to the government regarding salary payments etc. on behalf of DIOS Devendra Gupta. In this, considering Devendra Gupta's retirement on May 31, he had recommended attaching him to the directorate. Despite this, Devendra remains stationed in Ballia. It is alleged that before retirement, he is making arrear payments to 179 employees by taking a 25% commission. Several audio clips of this are also viral. In this matter, Congress MLA Virendra Chaudhary from Pharenda, Maharajganj district, complained to CM Yogi Adityanath on April 6, 2026. Jobs were also distributed to close relatives of influential people for 179 posts

stories.title: UP heatwave worsens as 23 districts on red alert:Banda hits highest 48°C again amid severe hot winds
stories.summary: UP has been in the grip of a heatwave for a week. Banda remained the hottest city in the country for the fourth consecutive day, where the maximum temperature was recorded at 48 degrees Celsius. On Wednesday, the temperature in Prayagraj was 46.4 °C, in Jhansi 45.9 °C, in Agra 45.3 °C, in Bulandshahr 45 °C, and in Kanpur 44.6 °C. On Thursday, most cities in UP are experiencing strong sunshine since morning. People are suffering from the heat. Today, there is a heatwave alert in 59 districts of the state. Among these, 23 districts have a red alert for heatwave. This means that conditions could become severe due to hot winds here. The effect of the heat is also visible on animals. In Etawah Safari, ACs have been installed in some lion enclosures, and coolers in others. In Noida, a monkey was seen swimming in a swimming pool. In Lucknow Zoo, water is being used to cool down the animals. The Meteorological Department says that dry and hot winds coming from Balochistan in Pakistan and the Thar Desert are directly reaching the plains of North India. Because of this, heat like the last week of May or June is being felt already. Lucknow's meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said- There is a possibility of severe heatwave across the state for the next one week. Nights will also be warm in Western UP. In the coming days, a rise of 2 to 3 degrees in temperature can be observed. Only leave home in the afternoon if there is a very important task. stories.title: BJP announces 5 UP MLC candidates:Avnish Singh gets Lucknow graduate seat; Umesh Dwivedi fielded from teacher constituency
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party has announced its candidates from the Graduate and Teacher constituencies for the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections 2026. The party's Central Election Committee approved the names for 5 seats on Saturday. BJP has made these candidates BJP currently has 79 members in the Legislative Council, while the Samajwadi Party (SP) has 10. BJP allies — Apna Dal (S), RLD, Nishad Party and SBSP — have one member each. Apart from this, Jansatta Dal Loktantrik and the Teachers’ Group (non-political) have one member each, while there are two members from the Independent group and two Independent MLCs. One seat is currently vacant. Elections to 11 Teachers’ and Graduates’ constituency seats in the Legislative Council are scheduled for December 2026, just ahead of the Assembly polls. Of these, BJP currently holds six seats, SP has three, while one seat each is held by the Teachers’ Group (non-political) and an Independent member. SP has so far announced 10 candidates for the MLC elections. The party has renominated sitting member Lal Bihari Yadav from the Mirzapur-Varanasi Teachers’ constituency. Sitting members Man Singh Yadav from the Allahabad-Jhansi Graduates’ constituency and Ashutosh Sinha from the Varanasi-Mirzapur Graduates’ constituency have also been given tickets again. Kamlesh has been fielded from the Gorakhpur-Faizabad Teachers’ constituency, while Kanti Singh will contest from the Lucknow Graduates’ seat. Pramendra Bhati has been named candidate from the Meerut-Saharanpur Graduates’ constituency and Dr Prakash Chandra Gupta from the Agra-Aligarh constituency. Haji Mohammad Danish Akhtar has been fielded from the Bareilly-Moradabad constituency, Shashank Yadav from Agra constituency and Nitin Kumar Tomar from the Meerut-Ghaziabad constituency.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Power supply lapses won’t be tolerated, says CM Yogi; actress Twisha cremated 12 days after death more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top headlines: 1. Trump tells Netanyahu he backs Israel’s freedom of action in Lebanon US President Donald Trump told Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu he supported Israel maintaining “freedom of action” against threats on all fronts, including Lebanon, CNN reported, citing an Israeli official. 2. Power supply lapses won’t be tolerated, says CM Yogi: Warns officials of strict action; orders energy minister to inspect field operations Amid the ongoing power crisis in Uttar Pradesh, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has said negligence in electricity supply will not be tolerated. He warned that any lapse at any level would invite strict action. 3. Lucknow mayor administers oath to SP councillor: Sushma Kharkwal backtracks after Allahabad HC froze her powers Lucknow’s BJP Mayor Sushma Kharkwal finally administered the oath of office to SP leader Lalit Tiwari as a corporator on Sunday. The SP corporator was sworn in three days after the Allahabad High Court froze all financial and administrative powers of the mayor. During this period, the mayor could neither spend from her discretionary funds nor take action against any employee. The swearing-in ceremony was held at the Municipal Corporation office in Lalbagh. 4. Actress Twisha cremated by brother 12 days after death Actress Twisha’s last rites were performed on Sunday, 12 days after her death. Her brother, Major Harshit, lit the funeral pyre at the Bhadbhada crematorium in Bhopal. Twisha’s mother and other family members broke down in tears during the final rites. 5. ‘Cockroach’ man launches campaign for Yamuna cleanup: Threatens to end life if river is not cleaned in Mathura Dressed as a cockroach and standing inside a filthy drain in Mathura, Deepak Sharma says he is fighting to save the Yamuna river, which he now considers his mother after losing his own. His unusual protest against untreated sewage flowing into the river has drawn attention across social media and political circles, with the 30-year-old activist claiming he is ready to sacrifice his life if the Yamuna is not cleaned. 6. Trainee aircraft makes emergency landing in Aligarh: Technical fault develops soon after take-off from airport, pilot lands plane in field A trainee aircraft was forced to make an emergency landing in Aligarh on Sunday morning at around 10:30 am after developing a technical fault mid-air. The aircraft, bearing registration VT-PFB, had taken off from Dhanipur Airport for a routine training flight. 7. BJP's Debangshu Panda wins Bengal’s Falta re-election The Election Commission of India has declared the final result of the re-election of the Falta constituency in West Bengal. According to the latest information, the BJP candidate Debangshu Panda has won the election by securing 1,49,666 total votes. 8. BJP MLA seeks ban on ‘Cockroach Party’ in UP: Akhilesh Yadav backs CJP; red-black ‘Hit’ trend goes viral The ‘Hit Janta Party’ (HJP) has now emerged in opposition to the ‘Cockroach Janta Party’ (CJP). Gen Z users on social media appear divided into two camps over the viral digital campaign. The impact of the online trend is now beginning to show in Uttar Pradesh politics as well. 9. Dog runs away with ₹1 lakh: Bijnor businessman lost cash from parked bike In Bijnor, a dog ran away with a bag containing 1 lakh rupees hanging on a bike, clutching it in its jaws. When the CCTV was examined, everyone was astonished by what they saw. Actually, 1 lakh rupees belonging to medicine businessman Nawab Ahmed went missing from a bike parked outside a mosque. As soon as he found out, the ground slipped from under Nawab's feet. 10. BCCI in favour of sacking Suryakumar Yadav A senior BCCI source told PTI that the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) selection panel is in favour of moving on from Surya, who hasn't recovered his form for a year now.

stories.title: Om Prakash Rajbhar targets Akhilesh over poverty jibe:Says, 'SP chief was born with a silver spoon'; vows BJP will crush the cycle in 2027
stories.summary: Yogi government minister and Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party (SBSP) chief Om Prakash Rajbhar drove an auto in Lucknow on Sunday. He drove the auto from the party office to his official residence. The minister said, Akhilesh Yadav has suggested that one should run the government while driving an auto. The message is that now Om Prakash Rajbhar is the auto driver. Earlier, Rajbhar posted a photo on X while driving an auto. Calling himself a leader who emerged from struggle, he described Akhilesh's politics as 'AC-PC and Twitter' based. He said, Akhilesh Yadav ji, you were born with a silver spoon, we were not. Your bright trolls are making fun of us and telling us our place, based on this very photo of ours. See 3 pictures Read exactly what Rajbhar wrote Go ahead, mock poverty Akhilesh Yadav ji, you were born with a silver spoon... we were not. Your uncouth trolls are making fun of us using this very photo, telling us our place... Know that this photo of ours is our pride, our honor and glory... So many memories of our days of struggle are embedded in it. Our struggle continues even today... Forget it... you won't understand... because you inherited big cars, dogs strolling in the lawn, foreign education, the power of authority, and a ready-made chief minister's chair. Which, after getting the chair, you have merely transformed into Twitter, AC, and PC politics. That's why auto-rickshaw drivers, street vendors, and poor people must seem like objects of ridicule to you. Like 2017, in 2027, we will crush the foreign cycle Make fun of poverty... and fly high to the seven heavens... just remember this: in 2027, these very tempo, rickshaw, cart, and street vendor owners will together overturn and crush your 2011 foreign bicycle, just like in 2017. 'Listening to the pain and suffering of the people is my politics' Akhilesh ji, when Om Prakash Rajbhar was going from village to village, raising the voice of the extremely backward, Dalits, and deprived... taking lathi blows... fighting for the rights of the poor, you were traveling abroad on your powerful father's wealth. You may be educated and well-read, but you are not cultured. That is why you entered politics by insulting your father and gained power. On the other hand, our father raised us in poverty, but we have entered politics not by insulting our father like you, but by taking his blessings. We have emerged from the pain of our society... For us, politics is not Twitter, AC, and PC. Our politics is to listen to the sorrows of the public by walking on village paths in the scorching 45-degree heat of the afternoon. 'For you, politics is drama' For you, politics might be 'drama'... for us, it is a struggle. You have played and grown up in the lap of power since childhood... We have fulfilled responsibilities since we gained consciousness, sometimes holding the handle of an auto-rickshaw, and sometimes the flag of a movement. Remember, O ignorant ruler... a man who has closely seen poverty, hunger, insult, and struggle cannot be intimidated by the winds of social media. Om Prakash Rajbhar does politics not to gain a position in power, but to empower the voice of the person standing on the very last rung of the extremely backward society. Why is Rajbhar angry with Akhilesh? Many SP supporters are posting pictures of Om Prakash Rajbhar on social media. An X account holder named Surendra Yadav wrote, "Oh, this gives Om Prakash Rajbhar ji's vibe from a distance. It seems he used to drive an auto first, then thought, 'When people can roam without a meter, why not politics without an issue?'" His auto must be very unique. If a passenger asks, 'Where will you go?', the answer would be, 'Wherever power goes!' He seems to be lowering the meter less and lowering statements more. And his face is such that even if you sit in the auto, you'll feel he's about to say, 'Our party is in a decisive role.' Minister Rajbhar had told - How a traffic inspector's slap changed his fate A week ago, in Ghazipur, Om Prakash Rajbhar shared an important incident from his life. He recounted how slaps from a police officer in Varanasi changed the direction of his life and inspired him to enter politics. Rajbhar said, he used to drive an auto at night in Varanasi and study during the day. One night in the Andhrapul area, out of compulsion, he took five passengers instead of three. At a crossroads, a TI (Traffic Inspector) tried to stop him, but he drove the auto forward. A little later, the police officer stopped him and slapped him two or three times in front of everyone. After this, he was taken to the police line and released after some time. According to Rajbhar, this incident proved to be the biggest turning point in his life. This humiliation shook him from within. While returning home, he silently vowed that one day this very system would salute him. During this time, he met Kanshi Ram, who showed him the path of politics and social struggle. His journey from an auto driver to becoming the voice of the people was filled with struggle, organization, and grassroots politics. Slowly, he gained recognition in the state's politics. In 2017, the same Omprakash Rajbhar became a minister in the Uttar Pradesh government. Even after becoming a minister, the memory of that TI who once slapped him remained fresh in his mind. After becoming a minister, Omprakash Rajbhar sought information about that TI from the District Magistrate of Varanasi. It was found that he was a resident of Allahabad and had retired. Rajbhar went directly to his house. Upon reaching there, he first saluted the former TI. In response, the officer also saluted him. Then Rajbhar smiled and said, "If you hadn't slapped me twice that day, perhaps I wouldn't have become a minister today." This is not just the story of a leader, but the story of that determination, struggle, and self-respect that turns even insult into a ladder to success.

stories.title: Mayawati calls herself 'Iron Lady':Warns party workers against negligence; asks them to counter every move by opponents
stories.summary: BSP supremo Mayawati held a major meeting in Lucknow on Sunday regarding the 2027 Assembly elections. She told party leaders in a stern tone - no kind of negligence in election preparations will be tolerated. The party organization needs to be more alert, efficient and vigilant. Every move of opposition parties must be countered with full strength. Mayawati appealed to the people of UP that they must trust BSP and its Iron Lady leadership once again. They must avoid the narrow and deceptive politics of opposition parties. A BSP government must be formed for the 5th time. Office bearers from booth level to district, assembly and state level participated in the meeting. Everyone presented their respective reports. Mayawati asked party leaders to strengthen the organization up to booth level, gather financial support for the party and increase the support base among all sections. 3 pictures from the meeting- Read what Mayawati said in the meeting? 1. Policies made in favor of wealthy businessmen are harming the public Mayawati said - The current political, social and economic conditions of the country are not good. Policies made in favor of big capitalists and wealthy businessmen are harming common people. Governments should fulfill their constitutional obligations. They should focus on public welfare. 2. Will have to contest elections with full strength like in 2007 Political parties make big promises during elections, but as soon as elections end, they distance themselves from public interest issues. This makes the public feel cheated. BSP government has worked four times on law and order, public welfare and giving respect to all sections of society. The party has always worked on the policy of 'Sarvajan Hitay, Sarvajan Sukhay' (welfare and happiness for all). 3. Will give opportunity to candidates who have good public support Will have to contest elections with full strength like in 2007. Will have to make the mission 'Press the button on elephant, return to power' successful. The party will give opportunity to such candidates who have a strong image and who have good public support. He advised workers to be cautious of the opposition's 'conspiracies and misleading propaganda'. 4. It is necessary to learn lessons from the assembly elections of five states It is necessary to learn lessons from what happened in the recently held assembly elections of five states. He said that keeping in view the assembly elections to be held in UP, Uttarakhand and Punjab in the beginning of next year or a little before that, the party will have to be alert in advance. 5. The country and people will not benefit from divisive politics In BSP's cadre meetings, it is necessary to tell people the truth that during elections, governments and parties show themselves to be very public-spirited and spend a lot of money, but as soon as the elections end, they turn their backs on their promises and announcements. This is why the country and people are not benefiting from the deceptive and divisive politics of these parties. 6. People will have to trust BSP like in 2007 BSP's goal is social transformation and economic liberation. Kanshi Ram dedicated his entire life to this very goal. Taking inspiration from him, I am continuously working hard to fulfill this objective. People will have to trust BSP like in 2007, when all weaker sections including the Brahmin community were brought out of neglect and insecurity and given respect and participation. 'Ground-level organizational strength is most essential to win elections' BSP district president of Kanpur Dehat, Ramakant Nirala said - In the meeting, Behanji reviewed the organization up to booth level. She emphasized on formation of all booth committees within the stipulated time. She said - Ground-level organizational strength is most essential to win elections. 'Behenji gave the mantra to form government in 2027' Devipatan Mandal in-charge Narendra Gautam said that Behenji gave workers the mantra to form government in 2027. He said that candidates should be such that they are visible among the public after winning. Currently, candidates have not been announced, but a clear indication has been given that only those who work hard in the field from now will get tickets. Behenji did not comment on the possible alliance with Congress. 'No discussion regarding alliance with Congress' Senior journalist Syed Qasim reported that some points were most important in the meeting. First, the BSP chief has shown some leniency in the old strict criteria for candidate selection. Second, caste equations will be considered important in ticket distribution. That means the candidate will be the one whose caste balance fits the concerned assembly seat. In the meeting that lasted about 1 hour 10 minutes, Mayawati did not discuss Congress MP Tanuj Punia, Congress Scheduled Caste Department head Rajendra Pal Gautam, or any alliance with Congress.

stories.title: Bulandshahr man kills father, wife over alleged affair:Shoots them with pistol; married a year ago, became father 10 days ago
stories.summary: A quack doctor allegedly shot dead his father and wife with a licensed pistol in Uttar Pradesh’s Bulandshahr district. He fired at his father’s temple and shot his wife in the chest and stomach before fleeing the scene. Both victims were found lying in pools of blood inside the house. Police rushed them to hospital, where doctors declared them dead. The incident took place on Sunday in Kalandargarhi village under Khurja Nagar Kotwali area, around 22 km from the district headquarters. The accused, Mobin (26), had married a year ago, and his wife had given birth to a baby boy just 10 days ago. According to police, preliminary investigation suggests that Mobin suspected an illicit relationship between his father and wife, which frequently led to disputes within the family. See pictures Murder due to suspicion of illicit relationship - SSP SSP Dinesh Kumar Singh said- A person named Momin shot his father Riyazuddin and his wife Sana with his father's licensed pistol. He suspected that his father had an illicit relationship with his wife. There had been several arguments over this matter before. The accused has been taken into custody and is being interrogated. SP Dehat Antariksh Jain said- Momin was absconding after committing the incident. With the help of CCTV cameras and the surveillance team, the accused was arrested from a distance of one and a half kilometers from his house. Interrogation of the accused is ongoing.

stories.title: Dog runs away with ₹1 lakh:Bijnor businessman lost cash from parked bike while he went to offer namaz
stories.summary: In Bijnor, a dog ran away with a bag containing 1 lakh rupees hanging on a bike, clutching it in its jaws. When the CCTV was examined, everyone was astonished by what they saw. Actually, 1 lakh rupees belonging to medicine businessman Nawab Ahmed went missing from a bike parked outside a mosque. As soon as he found out, the ground slipped from under Nawab's feet. Nawab started inquiring around. No one had seen any person near the bike. After being worried for quite some time, Nawab examined the CCTV footage installed nearby. Upon viewing, it was revealed that a black-colored dog approached the bike. It grabbed the bag full of money in its mouth and left from there. The incident occurred on Saturday afternoon outside the Qila Wali Mosque located near the old tehsil in the city Kotwali area. Nawab Ahmed says that he and people from the surrounding area are engaged in searching for the dog and the bag of money. Since the matter involves an animal, no complaint has been filed with the police. See the pictures- Now understand the entire matter in a sequential manner:- 'If God wills, the money will be returned' Nawab Ahmad says that whom should they complain against after all, because the one who took away the bag of money was not a human but an animal. If God wills, the money will be returned. Ram Pratap Singh, City Kotwaal, said that the matter has not come to notice. Action will be taken after investigation once a complaint is received.

stories.title: Young man beaten to death at Namo Ghat in Varanasi:10-12 guards thrashed him with rods sticks; victim had gone out with 5 friends
stories.summary: In Varanasi, a 17-year-old youth was beaten to death by bouncers and guards. The deceased's friend said that early Sunday morning, 5 friends had arrived to visit Namo Ghat. Private guards stopped them there. After an argument, they went to the other side. But on their return, 10-12 guards and bouncers surrounded them and started beating them. Chaos erupted at the ghat. When people gathered, the guards let them go. In this assault, one youth sustained serious injuries while four others were also injured. With the help of local people, the youth was taken to the divisional hospital but doctors declared him dead. The youth has been identified as Rajesh Jaiswal alias Chintu (17) from Sonbhadra. He had come to Banaras late Saturday evening to buy medicine. After buying medicine, he had gone to visit Namo Ghat with friends. Police have taken 4 accused into custody. Police say that nearby CCTVs are being checked. See pictures... Friend said - Guards came with 10 to 12 sticks Brijesh Gupta said - Rajesh Jaiswal had come to Banaras from Sonbhadra with his 4 friends. He had gone to get medicine for someone in his family. Rajesh's sister and brother-in-law also live in Banaras. That's why he stayed at their house at night. On Sunday at 3 AM, all five friends reached Namo Ghat for sightseeing. The guards stopped them there. This led to an argument between Rajesh and a guard. The guard started abusing and using foul language. On being abused, Rajesh also got angry. He said - why are you abusing? After this, Pintu got into an argument with the guard. The guard said - I will take down your arrogance right now. However, we friends stopped Rajesh and we moved to the other side. When they were returning, the guard along with his 10-12 companions stopped them. They started beating us. They beat Rajesh a lot. During this, Rajesh fell on the ground there, drenched in blood. CCTV will reveal the truth Brijesh Gupta said - The guards beat me too and chased me to kill me, so I ran away from there. While the guards also beat other boys. After this, a large number of people arrived. Companions took Rajesh to the hospital. Where doctors declared him dead. If the nearby CCTVs are examined, the truth will come out. ACP said - 5 boys had come from Sonbhadra for sightseeing ACP Vijay Pratap Singh said - Five youths from Sonbhadra had come to visit Varanasi. At 3 AM at the ramp built at Gate Number 2, private security guards are deployed. All of them had an argument and altercation with the youths. In the fight, one person Chintu Jaiswal has suffered serious injuries. The guard involved in this incident has been arrested. Interrogation is being conducted.

stories.title: Power supply lapses won’t be tolerated, says CM Yogi:Warns officials of strict action; orders energy minister to inspect field operations
stories.summary: Amid the ongoing power crisis in Uttar Pradesh, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has said negligence in electricity supply will not be tolerated. He warned that any lapse at any level would invite strict action. The Chief Minister directed Energy Minister Arvind Kumar Sharma and Minister of State Kailash Singh Rajput to visit the field and inspect power control rooms. He also instructed officials to ensure an uninterrupted electricity supply from villages to cities across the state. CM reviews power supply system with officials On Sunday, Yogi Adityanath reviewed the state’s power supply system during a meeting with officials from the Energy Department, Power Corporation and all DISCOMs. Energy Minister Arvind Kumar Sharma and Minister of State Kailash Singh Rajput were also present during the review meeting. During the review meeting on Uttar Pradesh’s power situation, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath issued several key directives to officials from the Energy Department, Power Corporation and DISCOMs. 1. Make power supply system more accountable Yogi told officials that strengthening the transmission system is crucial for ensuring a stable electricity supply. He said every effort should be made to minimise technical disruptions during the summer season. The Chief Minister directed officials to ensure constant monitoring of the transmission network. He also instructed that the state’s electricity supply system should become more accountable and consumer-centric. 2. Ensure quick response during storms and extreme heat The Chief Minister said negligence in resolving transformer breakdowns, feeder disruptions and consumer complaints would not be tolerated at any level. He directed officials to keep rapid response systems active at the field level even during storms, strong winds and severe heatwave conditions. Yogi also instructed that in areas with underground cables, prior permission must be taken from the concerned authorities before any digging work is carried out, so that the electricity supply is not affected. 3. Make smart meter system easier for consumers Yogi directed officials to make the smart meter system simpler and more beneficial for consumers. He said electricity is not merely a technical issue, but directly linked to people’s lives, irrigation for farmers, trade and industries. The Chief Minister instructed that field officers should be monitored regularly and consumer complaints resolved quickly. He warned of strict action in cases of negligence. He also directed Energy Minister Arvind Kumar Sharma and Minister of State Kailash Singh Rajput to physically inspect helpline call centres and review the arrangements. 4. Providing adequate electricity is government’s top priority The Chief Minister said ensuring adequate electricity supply to residents during summer remains the government’s highest priority and all DISCOMs must work together to achieve it. He also stressed the need for long-term energy planning keeping future demand in mind. Yogi further emphasised making consumer services more technology-driven and transparent. What officials told the CM Power demand rises sharply due to extreme heat Officials informed the Chief Minister that temperatures during April and May this year were significantly higher than last year, leading to a sharp rise in electricity demand across the state. Between April 15 and May 22, average daily electricity consumption increased from 501 million units to 561 million units. Maximum power demand also rose from 29,831 MW to 30,339 MW. Officials said Uttar Pradesh was the second-highest power-consuming state in the country on May 20, 21 and 22. Power banking arrangement maintained supply Officials informed the meeting that electricity generation at several power plants was affected after May 15 due to various reasons. Despite this, Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation managed the situation through power banking arrangements with 12 states. Between 2015 and 2026, the state signed agreements for a total electricity capacity of 32,305 MW, of which nearly 62% capacity was added during the past three years. New 1912 call centre service launched Officials said a new 1912 call centre service has been operational since November 2025 from Lucknow and Noida. With this, the daily call-handling capacity has increased from 75,000 to 90,000 calls. So far, 8.923 million smart meters have been installed across the state. Officials also informed the Chief Minister that, on government instructions, all smart prepaid meters have been converted back to the postpaid system. Smart meter consumers to receive monthly bills From June 2026, consumers using smart meters will receive monthly bills between the 1st and 10th of every month. Bills will also be sent through SMS, WhatsApp and email. Officials said special camps are being organised across the state from May 15 to June 30 to resolve complaints related to smart meters. Transformer failures have reduced significantly Officials informed the meeting that cases of transformer failures have reduced considerably over the past few years. While 429 power transformers had failed during 2022–23, the number has fallen to just 87 in 2025–26. Similarly, failures involving large distribution transformers with capacities above 100 KVA have also reduced sharply. In 2022–23, as many as 39,177 large transformers had failed, while the figure has come down to 20,292 in 2025–26. Officials said improvements in safety systems, timely repairs and fixed accountability were the key reasons behind the decline.

stories.title: UP minister’s son tells police ‘My father is a minister’:Scorpio with ‘MLA’ board and hooter stopped in Uttarakhand, fined
stories.summary: The Scorpio SUV belonging to the son of UP Minister of State Manohar Lal Panth, alias Mannu Kori was fined Rs 1,000 in Uttarakhand. On Saturday, the minister’s son was travelling to Badrinath with four friends while allegedly using a hooter on the vehicle. A traffic police sub-inspector in Pauri Garhwal noticed the SUV and stopped it for inspection. During checking, police found five youths travelling inside the Scorpio. The vehicle also had ‘MLA’ written on it. When Sub-Inspector Anil Rawat questioned the group, the minister’s son, Surendra Kumar, reportedly said: “My father is a Minister of State.” Following this, the sub-inspector informed senior officers. After questioning the occupants, police fined the vehicle, removed the hooter and covered the ‘MLA’ sign displayed above the number plate. The minister’s son later continued his journey towards Badrinath. See 3 pictures- Minister’s son says hooter installed to avoid traffic Police officers asked Surendra Kumar whether the MLA was present inside the vehicle. When he replied “No”, officers questioned why the vehicle was carrying an MLA board. “They asked whether MLAs’ children would also start moving around with official boards,” sources said. When questioned about the hooter, Surendra Kumar allegedly said it had been installed to avoid traffic congestion. Police officers reprimanded him and said it was inappropriate to use a hooter when the concerned public representative was not travelling in the vehicle. Minister’s second son linked to fatal accident three months ago Three months ago, another son of the minister, Naresh Panth, was involved in a road accident in which a young man died after being hit by a Fortuner SUV. At around 1 am on January 26, Anuj Yadav, 21, was returning home on a motorcycle along with his cousin Shivendra Yadav, 18, and Shankar, 45, after attending a Sunderkand recitation programme. At the same time, Naresh Panth was travelling with companions from Jakhalon towards Lalitpur. The Fortuner allegedly collided with the motorcycle near Howrah Bridge. All three riders sustained serious injuries in the crash. Shivendra Yadav later died during treatment. Following the incident, family members staged a protest by placing the body on the road and blocking traffic for nearly nine hours.

stories.title: Trainee aircraft makes emergency landing in Aligarh:Technical fault develops shortly after take-off, pilot lands in field
stories.summary: A trainee aircraft was forced to make an emergency landing in Aligarh on Sunday morning at around 10:30 am after developing a technical fault mid-air. The aircraft, bearing registration VT-PFB, had taken off from Dhanipur Airport for a routine training flight. Shortly after take-off, the aircraft reportedly developed a sudden technical problem while in the air. The pilot immediately informed the airport control room and safely landed the aircraft in fields near Changeri village in the Harduaganj area, away from residential locations. Panic among villagers after aircraft lands in field The sudden landing of the aircraft in an open field created panic among villagers in the surrounding area. Within minutes, a large crowd gathered at the site. However, the emergency landing was carried out safely and a major accident was avoided. The pilot also came out of the aircraft unharmed. Police and airport technical team reach spot After receiving information about the incident, the local police and the technical team from Dhanipur Airport left for the site. Officials have begun investigating the exact cause of the technical malfunction. See 2 pictures- DGCA team to investigate technical fault in trainee aircraft City Magistrate Atul Gupta said a training aircraft belonging to the Pioneer Flying Club at Aligarh Airport was safely landed in a field near Chanderi village after developing a technical fault. Instructor Asad and trainee pilot Kunal Kasera were on board the aircraft. Both are completely safe and the aircraft also did not suffer any damage. He said the incident took place at around 9:30 am. The aircraft had taken off from the airport at about 9 am. Shortly after take-off, a technical fault developed, following which the aircraft was precautionarily landed safely in the field. According to the City Magistrate, a team from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) is reaching the spot to investigate the cause of the technical malfunction. After the investigation is completed, the aircraft will be taken back to the airport. Both pilots have been sent to the district hospital as a precautionary measure. Officials said law and order at the site remains completely normal.

stories.title: Lucknow mayor administers oath to SP councillor:Sushma Kharkwal backtracks after Allahabad HC froze her powers, explains delay behind swearing-in
stories.summary: Lucknow’s BJP Mayor Sushma Kharkwal finally administered the oath of office to SP leader Lalit Tiwari as a corporator on Sunday. The SP corporator was sworn in three days after the Allahabad High Court froze all financial and administrative powers of the mayor. During this period, the mayor could neither spend from her discretionary funds nor take action against any employee. The swearing-in ceremony was held at the Municipal Corporation office in Lalbagh. Initially, all officials and attendees gathered at Rajkumar Hall for the ceremony. Later, the mayor announced that the oath would instead be administered in her chamber. Everyone then moved to the mayor’s office, where Lalit Tiwari took the oath in the presence of the Municipal Commissioner and other officials. Following the ceremony, the frozen powers of the Lucknow mayor were restored. Lalit Tiwari had challenged BJP candidate’s affidavit In the 2023 urban local body elections, Lalit Tiwari lost to BJP candidate Pradeep Kumar Shukla by 1,672 votes. Lalit later challenged Pradeep’s election affidavit in court, alleging that he had concealed details of his second marriage while filing nomination papers. After the allegations were proved, the court cancelled Pradeep Kumar Shukla’s election and directed that Lalit Tiwari be declared councillor. 3 pictures of the oath-taking ceremony- Mayor says oath administered on court’s directions Speaking after the ceremony, Mayor Sushma Kharkwal said- The oath has been administered in compliance with the High Court’s order. Since it was the court’s direction, the oath ceremony was conducted Responding to questions regarding the delay in administering the oath to the SP councillor, she said, A month ago, I attended an event in Mumbai attended by seven to eight mayors and municipal commissioners from across the country. After returning, my health suddenly deteriorated last Tuesday and I had to be admitted to the Army Hospital. I was discharged yesterday evening, and the oath ceremony was conducted this morning. The mayor further said that Pradeep Shukla had won the election by nearly 1,700 votes over Lalit. In many such cases, courts have ordered re-elections when nomination papers are found incorrect. However, in this case, instead of conducting fresh elections, an order was passed directing the oath to be administered to the candidate who came second. The Municipal Corporation and I complied with that order. The mayor further said that Pradeep Shukla had won the election by nearly 1,700 votes over Lalit. In many such cases, courts have ordered re-elections when nomination papers are found incorrect. However, in this case, instead of conducting fresh elections, an order was passed directing the oath to be administered to the candidate who came second. The Municipal Corporation and I complied with that order. New councillor says oath is ‘victory of justice’ Faizullaganj ward’s newly sworn-in councillor Lalit Tiwari said, With this oath, responsibilities have come upon my shoulders and I will try to fulfil them sincerely. My oath is a victory of justice. The order of the honourable court has been complied with, for which I express my gratitude. I will carefully examine all issues related to my ward and raise them in the council to ensure solutions. Legal adviser had recommended immediate oath ceremony Lucknow Municipal Corporation’s legal adviser, Prashant Singh Atal, had submitted his legal opinion to Municipal Commissioner Gaurav Kumar on Saturday. He stated that, under the law, petitioner Lalit Tiwari should be administered the oath at the earliest. He also advised that an affidavit be filed before the High Court informing it about compliance. He had further said that once the court’s order was complied with, all frozen powers of Mayor Sushma Kharkwal would automatically be restored. High Court had frozen mayor’s powers On Thursday, the Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court froze all financial and administrative powers of BJP Mayor Sushma Kharkwal. Following the order, the mayor was barred from spending funds or taking action against any employee. The High Court took the step over the failure to administer the oath to the SP corporator-elect. A bench comprising Justice Alok Mathur and Justice Qamar Hasan Rizvi had clearly stated that the mayor’s powers would remain frozen until the SP councillor was sworn in. The court had also directed that the District Magistrate and the Municipal Commissioner would temporarily handle all her responsibilities. Full case in detail During the 2023 Lucknow urban local body elections, BJP candidate Pradeep Kumar Shukla alias Tinku Shukla faced SP candidate Lalit Tiwari in a direct contest. In the vote count, Pradeep Kumar Shukla secured 4,972 votes, while Lalit Tiwari received 3,298 votes. Based on these results, Pradeep Kumar Shukla was declared elected. On May 13, 2023, Lalit Tiwari filed a petition in the Additional District Judge Court. The plea alleged that Pradeep Kumar Shukla had failed to provide mandatory information in election forms while filing nomination papers. The petition argued that the omission amounted to a violation of election rules and constituted misconduct. On this basis, Lalit challenged Pradeep’s election and sought cancellation of the result. Election cancelled five months ago The case was heard for nearly two-and-a-half years. During the proceedings, the court reviewed the affidavits, sworn declarations and election forms submitted at the time of the election. The court concluded that failure to disclose mandatory information during nomination amounted to a serious irregularity affecting the validity of the election. Based on these findings, the court on December 19, 2025 cancelled the election of Pradeep Kumar Shukla and declared Lalit Tiwari elected from Ward 73.

stories.title: Students accused of assaulting Varanasi influencer speak out:Claim she insulted them and topped exams through cheating
stories.summary: “Vaishnavi abused us and called us fat. She pulled our hair and ran away. What we did was a reaction to her actions. People have only seen half the video; they should watch the full clip. She may be a two-time topper, but she passes exams by cheating. “There has not been a single exam where a cheat sheet was not found with her. She has also harassed us through fake social media accounts. We do not want to escalate the matter further. Vaishnavi should delete the videos uploaded against us.” These allegations were made by Aishwarya Singh and Prachi Pandey, students from Varanasi accused of assaulting social media influencer Vaishnavi on May 22 at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapeeth. Vaishnavi lodged a complaint against both students at Sigra Police Station on May 23. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to both accused students about how the dispute began and how it escalated into a physical altercation. Students accuse Vaishnavi of harassment over three years Students Aishwarya Singh and Prachi Pandey are final-year BA Honours Mass Communication students at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapeeth in Varanasi. While narrating their version of events, both accused Vaishnavi of mentally harassing them for the past three years. Meanwhile, police also summoned both students to the Vidyapeeth outpost for questioning. First, know what the dispute was about Social media influencer Vaishnavi is also a final-year BA Honours Mass Communication student at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapeeth. She is popular on Instagram and has topped her class for the first two academic years. Her final examination was held at the Faculty of Humanities from 9 am to 12 pm on Friday. After the exam, students remained on campus, interacting and writing farewell messages on one another’s T-shirts to preserve memories. During this time, Vaishnavi reportedly got into an argument with classmates Priya and Aishwarya. It was alleged that the two students grabbed her and assaulted her. See 2 pictures- What accused student Prachi Pandey said Prachi said, It was the final day of our exams. All students were standing outside and talking after the paper. Just then Vaishnavi came and tried to make a reel with us. We refused because her reels are very odd. I did not want such videos to be made public. She further said, She then became aggressive and started abusing us. When we objected, she called me and Aishwarya fat. While leaving, she pulled my hair and said this is what people like us deserve. After that, the fight started. It was a reaction to her actions. Anyone in my place would have reacted similarly. Prachi further alleged that this is not the first time. Earlier too, she harassed me through comments posted from fake social media accounts. When I complained to the university administration, I was told that it was a personal social media matter and the university had nothing to do with it. Therefore, no complaint was officially registered. She also denied allegations made by Vaishnavi that they attempted to tear her clothes. If we had tried to tear her clothes, would they still be intact? We are girls too and understand the value of a woman’s dignity. Vaishnavi should delete the three-part video series she uploaded and end the matter. What Aishwarya Singh said Aishwarya said, There cannot be a dispute without any reason. Vaishnavi must have done something for this to happen. Everyone present there knows the truth. She abused us in language so offensive that I cannot even repeat it. It is never only one person’s fault in such matters; both sides contribute. She alleged that Vaishnavi was continuously posting videos to defame them. She uploaded a three-part series on Instagram about the controversy. The language used in those videos is insulting not just for us but also for our parents. Aishwarya further alleged that her mother uploaded a video targeting us and questioned our upbringing. She should first look at her own upbringing. We want to continue our studies peacefully. We do not want anything else. Our only demand is that Vaishnavi remove the videos. Aishwarya and Prachi also accused Vaishnavi of cheating in examinations. Background of the accused students Prachi Pandey’s father, Ranjan Kumar Pandey, is a teacher who also gives private tuition classes. Aishwarya’s father, Ranjan Kumar Singh, has passed away. He previously worked as a cable operator in the Haritirth area. Aishwarya has two brothers, both of whom are classmates of Vaishnavi. What Vaishnavi had alleged Vaishnavi had earlier claimed that she was leaving after her examination when a girl remarked, “She is walking in front of me, move her aside.” According to Vaishnavi, she replied, “Chup kar moti.” After this, the girl became angry, shouted at her and attacked her from behind. She alleged that Aishwarya Pandey was also involved. Vaishnavi later uploaded three videos on Instagram accusing Aishwarya Singh and Prachi Pandey of assaulting her and attempting to tear her kurta. She was seen crying in the videos. Police register case against accused students Sigra Police Station SHO Shivakant Mishra said- A case has been registered based on Vaishnavi’s complaint. Both students were called to the Vidyapeeth outpost and questioned. Evidence related to the case has been sought. Vaishnavi has also been asked to provide proof in support of her allegations

stories.title: ‘Cockroach’ man launches campaign for Yamuna cleanup:Threatens to end life if river is not cleaned in Mathura
stories.summary: 'After losing my mother, Yamunaji became my mother. I am deeply pained by her condition. My mother had been ill for years. Political parties have turned Mother Yamuna into an issue. Poison is being mixed into the river. My cockroach form will free Mother Yamuna from these filthy drains.' These are the words of Deepak Sharma, who arrived before officials in Mathura dressed as a cockroach and dancing in protest. When Dainik Bhaskar’s team met him on May 23 after his protest drew attention, he was standing inside a drain. Despite repeated requests, he refused to come out and narrated his anguish from there, breaking down in tears. Why is Deepak protesting in this manner? Why did he choose the form of a cockroach? What are his demands from the government and administration? Here is his story. First, know about Deepak Sharma Thirty-year-old Deepak Sharma lives with his family in the upscale Radha Florence society in Vrindavan. Until six months ago, he used to perform Katha-Bhagwat recitations. Now, however, he says he has devoted himself to social activism. Deepak said, “After losing my mother, I accepted Yamunaji as my mother. I am distressed by her condition.” Read the conversation with Deepak You are protesting dressed as a cockroach. Who is there in your family? My family includes my father Brajbihari, my wife Asha, my six-year-old daughter Pranika, and my two-and-a-half-year-old son Neelank. Apart from them, my paternal uncle and aunt’s husband are also with us. Until around six months ago, I used to perform priestly duties and recite Katha-Bhagwat. I spoke to people about religion and Sanatan Dharma. But now I have to save my mother. I have to make her healthy again. That is why I have dedicated my life to the country and society. First you protested at the Municipal Corporation, then inside the drain. What is the purpose? Dirty drains are being discharged into Lord Krishna’s Yamuna. During Lord Krishna’s time, there was Kaliya Naag here. But now poison is continuously being poured into Mother Yamuna through pollution. If this cockroach form can free my Mother Yamuna from these filthy drains, then even death is acceptable to me. As long as untreated sewage continues to flow into the river, I will not move from here. Yes, I first protested at the Municipal Corporation because the Supreme Court guidelines clearly state that the State is responsible for environmental and atmospheric issues. That is why I went to the civic body office. I had also filed a complaint on the Chief Minister’s portal, but there was no response. After I approached the Municipal Corporation, the Municipal Commissioner allegedly began threatening me over the phone. I kept receiving calls. So what should I do now? That is why I came directly into the drain to protest against it. You are refusing to come out of the drain. What if you fall ill? Today you are worried that I may fall ill. But my mother has been ill for years. Political parties have turned Mother Yamuna into an issue. Those responsible have still not sealed the drains flowing into the river. Why did you choose a cockroach costume for the protest? The term ‘cockroach’ was given by an honourable Supreme Court judge himself. We did not choose it. If someone who shows the government the mirror and fights against filth and pollution is called a cockroach, then I am proud of it. I say blind supporters should leave their political parties and come forward for Yamuna. Who prepares your cockroach look? I did the cockroach makeup myself. Coming out of my family and society, I launched this campaign on my own. I am risking my life for this. Mother Yamuna called me from her heart. Which songs do you dance to during the protest? I carry a portable speaker with me and connect it to my mobile phone. During the protest, I play songs and dance to them. I play the theme song of the Cockroach Janata Party. By dancing during the protest, I want passersby to become aware of Mother Yamuna. How many drains are flowing into the Yamuna? One drain is right in front of you, the one I am standing in. But thousands of drains are flowing into the Yamuna in Mathura. Until the water from these drains is treated before being discharged into the river, I will not come out. Are you influenced by the ideology of the Cockroach Janata Party? There cannot be a Cockroach Janata Party. Which party are you talking about? Under Election Commission guidelines, no such party can even be formed. Everything is in the government’s hands. When a party itself cannot officially exist, how can I be influenced by it? Now read about the Cockroach Janata Party The Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) is an online campaign. On May 16, a Google Form was shared on X carrying a poster with the words ‘Cockroach Janata Party’ and the caption: “A new platform is being launched for all cockroaches. If you want to join, click on the link. Four essential qualifications for joining were listed- On the same day, the official X handle of CJP — @CJP_2029 — along with the website and an Instagram account, were launched. Since then, people have continued joining the campaign. CJP has been accused of having most of its Instagram followers from countries such as Pakistan, Bangladesh and the United States. It was claimed that only 9% of followers were from India. However, the organisation says this is incorrect and claims that 96% of its followers are Indian. X account blocked, new handle created On May 21, CJP’s X account was blocked. Before suspension, the account had more than 1.93 lakh followers. Soon afterwards, the organisation created a new handle titled ‘Cockroach Is Back’. Its bio read: “Cockroach Don’t Die.” The first post from the new account was uploaded yesterday at 2:29 pm. Abhijit has also alleged attempts to hack the organisation’s Instagram account. On its website, CJP describes itself as a political platform for people “whom the system never counted”. The website further states: “Five demands, no sponsors, but a large and stubborn swarm.” CJI had said ‘some youth wander like cockroaches’ On May 15, 2026, during the hearing of a petition, Justice Surya Kant commented on unemployed youth. According to Live Law, he said: “There are youth wandering like cockroaches who are unable to find employment. Some become media activists, some social media activists, some RTI activists, and they begin attacking everyone.” The next day, the digital initiative called Cockroach Janata Party was launched. As controversy over the remarks grew, the CJI later clarified that his comments had been misrepresented. Abhijit studies in the US, previously worked with AAP Thirty-year-old Abhijit Deepke is a digital media strategist from Sambhaji Nagar in Maharashtra. According to reports, he studied journalism in Pune and is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Public Relations at Boston University in the United States. Abhijit worked as a social media strategist for Aam Aadmi Party between 2020 and 2022. During the 2020 Delhi Assembly elections, he reportedly created viral meme-based online campaign material for the party. In an interview, Abhijit said he left AAP due to personal and financial reasons before applying to Boston University. After securing admission, he moved to the US. On his X account, Abhijit has continued criticising the central government and Prime Minister Narendra Modi on issues ranging from the farmers’ protest to inflation.
